title: Can't find Goa photos
author: alex
text: I remember our Goa trip but not the month. Searching Goa used to show every photo in date order. Now I only get a few Best Matches and I cannot tell which beach day it was.

title: Prescription photo
author: sam
text: I know I took a picture of the medicine box when I was sick last winter. Searching medicine, January, and the drug name doesn't find it.
